meta.true_cost_formula: true cost/night = (nightly rate + mandatory resort fee) × (1 + 13.38% tax). Tax applies to room and fee in Clark County.

hotels.name: The Venetian / The Palazzo
hotels.address: 3355 Las Vegas Blvd S, Las Vegas, NV 89109
hotels.poker_on_site: Venetian Poker Room — The Palazzo, Level 2 (official poker page)
hotels.resort_fee_note: $55 plus tax per night, payable at check-in (mandatory)
hotels.tax_note: Daily rates do not include the applicable Clark County Room Tax of 13.38%.
hotels.parking: $20/day registered hotel guests; $20 Mon–Thu / $25 Fri–Sun non-hotel; valet $40/day; Sapphire+ self-park free
hotels.cancellation: Deposit (first night or full stay) billed at booking. Prepaid offers non-cancellable/non-refundable. Check-out prior to scheduled departure: $100 + tax. Incidental deposit $150/night.
hotels.poker_rate: $119 / $209 starting rates (Luxury King Suite, single/double), code EPOKR25 by phone 866.255.8936; conditional on 6 hrs live cash play OR a $300+ tournament buy-in per night; blackout dates may apply

hotels.name: Wynn Las Vegas / Encore
hotels.address: 3131 Las Vegas Blvd S, Las Vegas, NV 89109
hotels.poker_on_site: Wynn Poker Room — located in Encore (official poker page / WPT terms)
hotels.resort_fee_note: A daily resort fee of $55 plus tax for each room night (Resort rooms and Tower Suites)
hotels.tax_note: Clark County Room Tax of 13.38% applies county-wide (stated on official Venetian hotel terms; Wynn page states '$55 plus tax' without a rate)
hotels.parking: Complimentary self-parking for up to 2 vehicles included with resort fee (Tower Suites: valet or self-park)
hotels.cancellation: For the read offer: full deposit of all room nights and tax at booking; reservations non-cancellable/non-refundable/non-changeable; $150/night incidentals at check-in. Cancellation terms are rate-specific — confirm at booking.
